addHint: An undeclared key is stored exactly like a declared one; declare it on the Facets screen to browse by it.
deleteAttributeConfirm: Delete the {{scope}} attribute “{{key}}” from this entity? This cannot be undone.
deleteConfirm: Delete the {{memberType}} facet “{{key}}”? Its EntityAttribute values are untouched; only the axis declaration is removed. Any saved dynamic group that references it keeps working. This cannot be undone.
description: Classification axes for browsing and filtering — declare which attribute keys are facets
invalidBoolean: A {{type}} facet takes true or false.
invalidDouble: “{{value}}” is not a number, and a {{type}} facet stores nothing else.
invalidLong: “{{value}}” is not a whole number, and a {{type}} facet stores nothing else.
keyRequired: A facet needs an attribute key.
labelDescription: Optional. Display name for the axis; defaults to the key.
noFacetsDeclared: No facets are declared for this family yet. Declare one on the Facets screen to give it a value here.
otherIntro: Everything else this entity carries. Values reported by the device (CLIENT) or set by the platform (SERVER) are shown for reference — a facet filter does not read them.
title: Facets
usedByGroups: Changing this value moves this entity in or out of: {{groups}}
valueRequired: Enter a value, or use Clear to remove it.
valuesDescription: Optional. Comma-separated vocabulary for typeahead; leave blank for free-form.
valuesIntro: A facet's value lives on the entity, not in the registry. Browse matches these values — a declared axis with no value here matches nothing.
